articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Q: Companies Are Outlining Their 2026 Plans. What Are They Saying?. Forecasters at jobs site Indeed expect relatively minimal hiring growth in 2026. E-commerce platform Shopify and Chime Financial vow to keep the size of their employee bases roughly flat. The unemployment rate rose to 4.6% in November, its highest in four years.
